snippet.title: Borderlands 4 - Bounty Pack 3: A Zane to Kill For | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Solve the neon-noir mystery of who killed Zane's Digi-Clone, hunt down a new Pearlescent weapon and 6 new pieces of Legendary loot, and 24 cosmetic items and 4 pieces of rerollable Legendary gear with Vault Card 3! https://epic.gm/borderlands4

Both Bounty Pack 3: A Zane to Kill for and Bounty Pack 3: Vault Card 3 are now available. Starting with Bounty Pack 3, we're releasing DLC in two distinct parts that you can purchase individually.

Bounty Pack 3: A Zane to Kill For includes: 
New mission featuring a new boss and 2 new mini-bosses that can drop a new Pearlescent weapon and 6 new pieces of Legendary loot! Unravel the mystery of who killed Zane's Digi-Clone in this repeatable mission focused on everyone's favorite hitman turned Vault Hunter. Complete the mission to score new rewards: a Vault Hunter Skin usable by all Vault Hunters, a Vehicle, and an ECHO-4 Drone Skin.  

Bounty Pack 3: Vault Card 3 includes:
4 rerollable pieces of Legendary gear, 4 Vault Hunter Heads usable by all Vault Hunters, 4 Vault Hunter Skins usable by all Vault Hunters, 5 Weapon Skins, 5 Vehicle Skins, 4 ECHO-4 Drone Skins, and 2 ECHO-4 Attachments.
